visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with glasses, wearing an oversized white T-shirt with cherry prints, stands inside a massive, open cardboard box in an outdoor residential alley during twilight. He gestures enthusiastically with both hands spread wide, looking directly at the camera while large white and yellow Chinese text overlays appear on the screen. (2) The scene shifts to a younger girl with voluminous curly hair standing inside the box. A man in a black T-shirt helps her as the box suddenly tips over toward the camera, causing the girl to fall inside. Colorful, shocked-face emojis are superimposed over the scene to emphasize the comedic moment. (3) The girl is later shown emerging from the box covered in a white translucent fabric veil. The host man dances around the box with dramatic gestures, as if presenting a prized item, while white sparkling visual effects decorate the frame around her. (4) An elderly woman using a silver walker is guided into the box by the host man. She wears a checkered pink and blue top and looks slightly confused but cooperative. The man adjusts the white fabric over her and partially closes the box flaps in the dimly lit alleyway. (5) The host man opens the box flaps to 'deliver' the elderly woman, who smiles while he sings and gestures toward her. The video concludes with multiple family members gathering near the box, laughing and talking together as the camera moves slightly in a handheld fashion.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a bright, high-energy male voice speaking Traditional Chinese at a rapid pace. An upbeat, major-key electronic pop BGM with a strong kick drum and synthetic melodies plays continuously in the background at approximately 125 BPM. (2) A sharp, percussive 'thud' sound effect marks a transition where a younger female voice lets out a loud, high-pitched laugh. This is followed by a series of cartoon-style 'pop' and 'boing' SFX as characters move quickly on screen. (3) The male host begins singing a comedic phrase with high vocal tension and a dramatic rising intonation contour. The BGM swells slightly to support the vocals, while distant chatter and footsteps are audible in the room tone. (4) As the scene introduces an elderly woman, the vocal tone becomes slightly softer but remains humorous and friendly. A metallic 'clack' from a walker is heard, followed by a 'whoosh' transition sound effect as the cardboard box flaps are moved. (5) The audio concludes with a crescendo of laughter from at least three distinct voices—one male and two females—overlapping with the BGM. A final high-pitched digital chime SFX signals the end of the recording.
